trailhead.label: car park P 7 on the south shore at Techendorf, the board’s start (Nordic Walking centre “Süd”)

cautions: Steep: 385 m of climbing in 3.1 km, with about 500 m of steep, rough track that OpenStreetMap grades as demanding mountain hiking (T3): sure-footed walking, no exposure.
Cattle may graze the Naggler Alm pastures in summer: short lead, give the herd room.
Forest tracks open to forestry vehicles.
No water point is listed on this walk: carry enough for you and your dog.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
